title: Mylar3
descript: [Mylar3](https://github.com/MylarComics/mylar3) is an automated Comic Book downloader (cbr/cbz) for use with NZB and torrents written in python. It supports SABnzbd, NZBGET, and many torrent clients in addition to DDL. Packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7: the official Docker Hub image runs as a container on your NAS, keeps its data in the application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/mylar3docker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-cn.descript: 美漫自动下载与管理工具。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/mylar3docker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
